title: Which model should power the supervising assistant?
description: The existing starter uses a hosted OpenAI model. Local application execution does not mean local model inference. Choose provider strategy and record an acceptable per-task budget before live evaluation. Worker subscription/login choices are independent of the supervisor model.
why: The existing starter uses a hosted OpenAI model. Local application execution does not mean local model inference. Choose provider strategy and record an acceptable per-task budget before live evaluation. Worker subscription/login choices are independent of the supervisor model.

recommendation.why: Fastest way to measure supervision reliability using the starter

decision.rationale: Recorded on the user's behalf under explicit authorization to work through the full plan and prior explicit choice to run a local Ollama model; keep supervision inference local while measuring tool reliability.
